_note: Golden-image regression suite for Raves' menu screens, run through highvisor. Each scene's `reset` clicks the sub-screens' Back spot (140,952) to return to the menu first (a no-op at the menu), so the suite is robust to run order + re-runs from menu OR any sub-screen. Golden regression:  hv scene --all --config tools/regression/scenes.json  (add --bless after an intended change). Live parity vs Qud (--parity) needs each `reference` (Qud) started at its TITLE, so run it PER SCENE (hv scene mods --parity), not --all, since Qud has no shared reset. Coordinates are window-relative points at 1793x997.
_options_note: options mirrors the LOCAL Qud options tree (options.json, extracted by the mod), so its golden is data-dependent — re-bless after options.json changes (e.g. the mod exports live values). Use --parity vs Qud for the real cross-check.
